signal: Olo was taken private by Thoma Bravo in a $2B deal and is launching the commission-free Olo App and Olo Network in late 2026

email.body1:
Michelle, saw Olo went private with Thoma Bravo and is rolling out the commission-free Olo App and Network later this year.

A new platform play usually means more enterprise brands worth a conversation than the team can cover before momentum stalls. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so enterprise coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Olo off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Michelle, quick follow-up for Olo.

Post-take-private, expectations on enterprise pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings each rep needs to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Olo needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Michelle, last bit of proof for Olo.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Olo's enterprise reply rate likely compares to other restaurant-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Michelle, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A take-private plus a platform launch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Olo either way.
